notes.title: 1.4.5: Unity bump + some ultrawide monitor love
notes.content:
Hello again, another month, another update.

List of changes:
[list]
[*] New unity version build. It should bring some multi-threaded performance increases.

notes.title: 1.4.0: New event chains update
notes.content:
Hey guys! In this update, I added more content to play around with in the shape of event chains. Here is the list of all changes:
[list]
[*] A bunch of new events with 7 base variations.
[*] Your station size now affects how fast pirates gather strength.
[*] Fixed a bug that wouldn't hide items already bought by the traders from the player.
[*] Fixed the bug where a large turret would fire smaller projectiles.
[*] All projectiles now consume more ammo per shot.
[*] Reduced ship order max margin back to 2.5x.
[*] Fixed an issue where undocked trade ships wouldn't stop selling their items on the market if the game was loaded.
[/list]

[*] Dramatically increased the number of ships spawned.
[*] Increased the minimum amount of spawned ships per faction.
[*] Changed how negative colour is calculated for the relations bars.
[*] Improved main menu UX.
[*] Implemented an "Auto buy fuel" feature.
[*] Added new tutorial steps.
[*] Increased trader buy chance 10% => 15%.
[*] Increased the relationship reduction on a ship if hit or destroyed by the player.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed how the bar fill rate is calculated. Now both the parent faction and the sub-faction values are combined.
[*] Fixed a bug which would stack technology bonuses after each load.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.0: QOL and bug fixes!
notes.content:
This is the first minor update for Your spaceport. [u]I suggest that you remove existing saves as they might have incorrect data stored. The saving/loading part of the game has changed significantly.[/u]

  Things that changed:

[b]Turrets:[/b]
[list]
[*] Turrets now rotate even if the player has no ammo.
[*] The player will be notified if they are trying to fire without any ammo.
[*] Turrets can now be dismantled and placed back into the player's inventory.
[*] Fixed a bug which would move some projectiles faster and others not at all.
[/list]
[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the Delete Save button to the Load window.
[*] The Manufacture window now shows the player what they can and can't manufacture.
[*] The player can now directly switch between windows without having to close the opened one first.
[*] Price charts now re-render immediately when loading from a save.
[*] The last tutorial now doesn't show up when the game is loaded from a save.
[*] There was a chance that some items in the market and the inventory would be displayed larger than the other items. This has now been resolved.
[*] In the price history window, turrets are now grouped.
[*] The player is now notified that they bought fuel and that the fuel tankers should arrive in the next minute or so.
[*] Added colour indicators when changing utility prices so that the player now knows if the prices will hurt their relationship with other factions.
[*] Fixed the display of partially researched technologies when a game would be loaded.
[*] Fixed a tutorial bug which would brick the tutorial handler if the player used/consumed the item which was used as a display reference.
[*] Fixed a bug which would display a faulty queue index in the research window.
[/list]
[b]Controls:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a hotkey for the camera to start moving towards the station.
[*] Tutorials:
[*] Added new "Move camera" to station tutorial
[*] Added new Dismantle turret tutorial
[/list]
[b]Manufacturing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug which would prevent the player from manufacturing if the game was loaded from a save.
[*] Fixed how ship manufacturing would resume when the game was loaded.
[*] Fixed a bug which would allow an incorrect type of trade route to place ship orders.
[/list]
[b]Ships:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ships now correctly resume their previous activity when the game is loaded from a save.
[*] Fixed how ship sleep time is calculated when saving the game
[*] Fixed what ships do when they are docked and the game was loaded from a save file.
[*] Each tanker can now carry less fuel 192 => 128
[*] The wait times between tankers spawning have doubled.
[*] Tankers now move 50% faster.
[/list]
[b]Inventory:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an item duplication bug which would happen when the game would load from a save file.
[/list]
[b]Audio:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed how the audio loops. There shouldn't be any more random cut-offs. 
[/list]
[b]Research:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a research bug which would accurately unlock researched technologies on the first game load from a save file, but would then completely remove all research on the next load.
[/list]
[b]Relations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Buying fuel from a faction now increases relations depending on the amount of fuel bought.
[*] Relation reduction when the player has no spare parts was reduced 10X.
[*] Fixed a bug which would incorrectly handle active events when the game was loaded from a save.
[/list]
[b]Market:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug which wouldn't correctly show docked trader items on the market if the game was loaded.
[*] Players' market items are now correctly displayed when the game is loaded.
[*] Fixed a bug, which wouldn't colour player's items on the market correctly.
[/list]
